ships.name: USS Nimitz
ships.status: , USS Nimitz moored at Pier 14N in its new homeport of Naval Station Norfolk, for the first time in nearly 40 years, after a four-month transit from Bremerton, Washington.

ships.name: USS Dwight D. Eisenhower
ships.status: June 17, USS Dwight D. Eisenhower departed Naval Station Norfolk for FRS-CQ, in the Virginia Capes Op. Area; Arrived in the Jacksonville Op. Area on June 26; Conducted TRACOM-CQ from June 27-29; Moored at Pier 11S on July 2; Underway again on July 22; Conducted ammo onload with the USNS Medgar Evers (T-AKE 13) on July 24.

ships.name: USS Carl Vinson
ships.status: June 13, 2026 USS Carl Vinson moored at Berth Lima on Naval Air Station North Island after a three-day underway for sea trials, following a  nine-month Planned Incremental Availability (PIA); Underway again from June 25- July 1; Underway for flight deck certification and CQ, with the CVW-2, on July 10; Moored at Kilo Pier on July 17.

ships.name: USS Theodore Roosevelt
ships.status: July 7, USS Theodore Roosevelt departed Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam for at-sea phase of RIMPAC 2026; Conducted a replenishment-at-sea with the USNS Guadalupe (T-AO 200), while underway south of Oahu, on July 8; Participated in a PHOTOEX, while underway approx. 100 n.m. northeast of Kauai, on July 22.

ships.name: USS Abraham Lincoln
ships.status: July 4, The Abraham Lincoln conducted a replenishment-at-sea with the USNS Cesar Chavez, while underway in the North Arabian Sea.

ships.name: USS George Washington
ships.status: From July 24-25, the George Washington CSG conducted operations southwest of Luzon, Philippines.

ships.name: USS John C. Stennis
ships.status: No recent status found.

ships.name: USS Harry S. Truman
ships.status: No recent status found.

ships.name: USS Ronald Reagan
ships.status: November 12,  USS Ronald Reagan moored at Bravo Pier on Naval Base Kitsap-Bremerton; Underway for FRS-CQ, in the SOCAL Op. Area, from Dec. 2-13.

ships.name: USS George H.W. Bush
ships.status: , An MH-60S Seahawk, assigned to the "Nightdippers" of Helicopter Sea Combat Squadron (HSC) 5, conducted an emergency water landing in the North Arabian Sea, around 11:30 a.m. local time. Three of the  four crew members have been recovered. Cmdr. Gabriel V. Edwards, CO of the HSC-5, was lost at sea.

ships.name: USS Gerald R. Ford
ships.status: , USS Gerald R. Ford moored at Pier 11N on Naval Station Norfolk following a record-breaking 326-day deployment in the U.S. 4th, 5th and 6th Fleet Areas of Responsibility (AoR).

ships.name: USS Wasp
ships.status: April 14, USS Wasp moored at Berth 6, Pier 11 on Naval Station Norfolk after a 10-day underway for deck landing qualifications, in the Virginia Capes Op. Area; Underway again on April 28; Moored at Berth 6, Pier 6 on May 9; Moved "dead-stick" to Pier 1 in BAE Systems shipyard on May 19.

ships.name: USS Essex
ships.status: No recent status found.

ships.name: USS Kearsarge
ships.status: July 10, The Kearsarge moored at Berth 4, Pier 14 on Naval Station Norfolk; Underway off the coast of Virginia from July 14-15.

ships.name: USS Boxer
ships.status: No recent status found.

ships.name: USS Bataan
ships.status: July ?, 2025 USS Bataan undocked and moored at  Berth 2E on NASSCO shipyard.

ships.name: USS Iwo Jima
ships.status: , USS Iwo Jima moored at Berth 2, Pier 14 on Naval Station Norfolk following a nearly 10-month deployment in the U.S. 2nd and 4th Fleet AoR.

ships.name: USS Makin Island
ships.status: July 2, USS Makin Island moored at Berth 5, Pier 8 on Naval Base San Diego after a two-week underway for  Amphibious Squadron (PHIBRON) 7/Marine Expeditionary Unit Integration Training (PMINT), with the 13th MEU; Underway for ARG/MEUEX   on July 15.

ships.name: USS America
ships.status: , USS America moored at Berth 5, Pier 13 in its new homeport of Naval Base San Diego after forward-deployed to Japan for nearly six years.

ships.name: USS Tripoli
ships.status: June 30, USS Tripoli ARG participated in a PHOTOEX with the USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN 72), USS George H.W. Bush (CVN 77) and 14 other U.S. Navy ships, while underway as a "show of force" in the North Arabian Sea; Transited the Sunda Strait northbound on July 13;   Moored at Navy Pier  East on White Beach Naval Facility for offload from July 22-25.
